Always verify rotation_distance empirically with generic motors. Thread quality varies and Z banding from pitch inconsistency is a common complaint, especially visible on tall cylindrical prints. Workable for a budget first build; for a machine you're tuning for quality, the LDO upgrade is worth the cost.
